== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-ming-huo-ds-that-things-operational/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Huo DS TTO.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114035621/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-ming-huo-ds-that-things-operational.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>a5778d39d45d1b00eea91fd3088b795c5921a423b55095caba60fbe19950fbaa</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 28 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Slave I, Symbol Of Fear (ALT) (Errata 3)]]: XML <nowiki>201_40^</nowiki>. The explicit XML image variant is represented by the existing ALT article and its matching published image.

=== Wording in the import reference ===
These links use the existing article with the requested card identity. The engine reference associated with the XML code and that article have the following wording differences; neither the card article nor the download was rewritten to erase them.
* [[Saber 4 (PC Errata)]] (<nowiki>9_165</nowiki>, gameText): engine reference <nowiki>May deploy with a pilot as a 'react' to a battle initiated against a TIE (for free if TIE is in Saber Squadron). May add 1 pilot. Immune to attrition < 4 when DS-181-4 piloting.</nowiki>; card article <nowiki>May deploy with a pilot as a 'react' to a battle where you have a TIE (for free if TIE is in Saber Squadron). May add 1 pilot. Immune to attrition < 4 when DS-181-4 piloting.</nowiki>.
